args.body: Thank you for your email. First, a correction: our earlier email said no issues were found, but the attached inspection report does record two things: a dog flap installed by the tenants (noted in the utility room/back door), and sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall which the tenant is to remove and make good. Apologies for the confusion. Our records do not show that consent was given for the dog flap, and they do not show a lock change or who holds a spare front door key. We are asking the tenant today whether consent was given, who changed the lock and when, and asking for a spare key to be sent to us by 25/02/2024. We will update you by 22/02/2024. Please also confirm whether you gave the tenants any consent, and note your email was signed Felix Clarke while our record names Oliver Bennett as landlord - could you confirm who wrote it?

args.body: Hi, thanks for having us in for the inspection. Two things please. 1) Our inspection noted a dog flap fitted in the back door. Changes like this need the landlord's written consent under the tenancy's alterations clause (and pets clause). Was consent given, and by whom? 2) We understand the front door lock may have been changed. Could you tell us who changed it and when, and send a spare front door key to our office by 25/02/2024 so we have one in case of emergency? We'll only enter with proper notice. Also, the inspector noted marks on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window (like command strip stickers) - please remove them and make good. We'll be in touch again by 22/02/2024.
